name: When I'm in a Competition and My Opponent Is
aka: Whe I'm in a Competition and My Opponent Is
look: Bold black text on a white strip reads "when I'm in a", then a gap, then "competition and my opponent is". Below it, a blurry, low-quality SpongeBob SquarePants frame shows Squidward's pale face up close with huge, round, dazed eyes against a blue underwater background.
use: Fill the gap with a silly contest, like being late or staring, and label the picture below as the opponent, someone or something that would obviously win. The dazed Squidward stands in for that unbeatable rival.
slots: the kind of contest (in the gap before "competition")
the unbeatable opponent (label on the Squidward picture)
examples: my friend who texts "on my way" from the shower
describe: squidward with big dazed eyes under text about a competition
blurry squidward face staring with wide round eyes
low quality spongebob picture of squidward looking stunned
meme text says when im in a competition and my opponent is
squidward hypnotized look as the unbeatable opponent
fill in the blank contest meme with a weird squidward picture
origin: Uses a blurry, zoomed-in frame of Squidward from SpongeBob SquarePants under a fill-in-the-blank caption.
